newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to higher.

text.p: Spot millfeed values were mostly steady to higher in light business, but many dealers said the frigid cold forecast this week for the central Midwest could boost demand.
Cold weather increases livestock feed consumption and the Arctic air expected in the central U.S. beginning Monday could have farmers and ranchers stockpiling feed ahead of the cold.
A Minneapolis dealer already is reporting tight supplies for prompt shipment. "It is going to be $110 (per ton) if anybody has anything," he said.
Weather forecasters said an Arctic airmass was forecast to push sub-zero Fahrenheit temperatures into central Texas by Wednesday, and the cold spell should last through early next week.
